title: Кібератака UAC-0057: експлойт для CVE-2023-38831, JavaScript-варіація PicassoLoader, алгоритм Rabbit та Cobalt Strike Beacon (CERT-UA#7435)

entities.name: UAC-0057
entities.gloss: A threat actor group known for conducting cyberespionage operations against Ukrainian targets.

entities.name: CVE-2023-38831
entities.gloss: A vulnerability in WinRAR allowing code execution when attempting to view benign files within a specially crafted archive.

entities.name: WinRAR
entities.gloss: A widely used file archiver and compression tool for Windows.

entities.name: Cobalt Strike Beacon
entities.gloss: A post-exploitation payload associated with the commercial penetration testing tool Cobalt Strike.

entities.name: PicassoLoader
entities.gloss: A malware loader used to decode and execute embedded or remotely fetched payloads.
